units.source_text: 比目魚一天到晚總是板著一張冰冷的臉，無論我怎麼賠笑，仍看不到他的一絲笑容。

en.t: Hirame kept a cold, stern face all day long, and no matter how much I smiled appeasingly, I still could not see even the slightest smile from him.

units.source_text: 人這種物種，怎麼能如此輕易、正所謂易如反掌地變臉呢？

en.t: How can human beings change their faces so easily, truly as easily as turning over the palm of a hand?

units.source_text: 這讓我感到可恥與噁心，不，莫如說是滑稽。

en.t: It made me feel ashamed and sickened; no, it would be closer to say it seemed ridiculous.

units.source_text: 比目魚一改常態，不停地反覆警告我：「不準出去，總之，禁止你出去。」

en.t: Hirame, quite unlike his usual self, kept warning me over and over: "You must not go out. In any case, you are forbidden to go out."

units.source_text: 比目魚總是死盯著我，怕我自殺，也就是說，

en.t: Hirame was always watching me closely, afraid that I might kill myself; that is to say,

units.source_text: 他認定我有追隨那個女人投海尋短見的嫌疑，嚴禁我外出。

en.t: He had decided that I was likely to follow that woman into the sea and take my own life, and he strictly forbade me to go out.
